name: Manifold Dual Contouring
definition: A contouring and simplification method that constructs a manifold surface by integrating a topology constraint into an adaptive vertex clustering algorithm, allowing independent simplification of multiple contour components within an octree cell.
summary: Manifold Dual Contouring constructs topologically correct, simplified iso-surfaces from Hermite data by integrating a topology constraint into adaptive vertex clustering, allowing multiple contour intersections per edge.
